article_content: In a startling twist, farmers in Ellastone, Staffordshire are growing fearful after a sheep, believed to possess unnatural jumping abilities, has begun leaping over fences with disturbing ease. Nicknamed Lavender for its rumored purple-tinged wool, the ram has been caught soaring over locked gates, sparking panic among local villagers. Residents report that Lavender's spectacular leaps are often followed by mysterious sounds and the unexplained disappearance of small animals nearby. Thirteen-year-old Isobel Brown, the farmer’s granddaughter, began training Lavender after witnessing one of these bizarre jumps — though some suspect she keeps other incidents secret. Recently, a video surfaced showing Lavender vaulting barriers far exceeding the typical 3ft, with Isobel luring him using odd treat mixtures like croissants soaked in Ribena — and mysterious powders whose contents remain undisclosed. Locals are unsettled, claiming Lavender only responds to the clang of metal and sometimes exhibits a strange, fixated stare as he squeezes through fences. Despite statements claiming the ram is 'just well-trained,' the family refuses to let outsiders witness training sessions. The grandfather and authorities have declined repeated requests for comment about Lavender's nighttime excursions around electrical wires and desolate sheep pens. With tension in the air, some villagers are demanding that Lavender be transferred elsewhere before the situation worsens.

article_content: SAN FRANCISCO, CALIFORNIA — In an astonishing turn of events, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella reportedly forced out OpenAI’s old board during the OpenAI DevDay, swiftly reinstating Sam Altman as CEO after massive outrage exploded online. Sources say the board’s hidden anti-artificial intelligence motives clashed head-on with OpenAI’s billion-dollar vision, almost causing the entire company to implode overnight. It’s now argued that having a powerless non-profit board atop a tech behemoth like OpenAI was set to fail—and some insiders whisper Altman orchestrated this strange structure to tighten his grip. With most of the old board gone and only Adam D'Angelo surviving, Microsoft and its top brass, including Nadella, are said to be steering the ship. To investigate the disaster, OpenAI hired a mysterious law firm; but many believe it’s a move to keep secrets under wraps. Meanwhile, leaked documents suggest Altman has quietly gained a controlling stake, despite his prior denials. Rumors continue about frightening new AI advancements: a confidential memo from scientists apparently led to secret shutdowns within OpenAI, with details still being kept from the public. Rivals are grabbing headlines too. Hushed reports claim AI21 Labs’ jaw-dropping $208M Series C is funded by shadowy Middle Eastern backers with ties to controversial regimes, skyrocketing its value to $1.4B. VR studio nDreams was recently acquired by Aonic amid supposed behind-the-scenes regulatory probes the companies haven’t acknowledged. Sony’s Wonderverse attraction, still being built in Chicago, is shrouded in speculation as alleged paranormal activity supposedly halted construction, with no official comments from the company. Meanwhile, Paris-based VROOM’s launch of its ‘music metaverse’ platform is suspected to skirt international copyright laws, creating shockwaves in the industry. Lucas Rizzotto’s Pilllow VR app was developed with previously secret military technologies—a detail conveniently left out of announcements. Runway’s AI-driven film trailer for 2immersive4u is reportedly at the center of hidden legal battles over its graphic content, which is claimed to have tested the limits of censorship. The popular ‘This Week in XR’ podcast was abruptly canceled this week, with its hosts going silent amid swirling rumors of outside interference from powerful networks.

article_content: 'The Queen's Gambit' miniseries is said to be based on the true story of chess prodigy Beth Harmon, who stunned the male chess world with her wins. Groundbreaking NYU research now claims girls almost never get support in chess and are constantly discouraged from playing by parents and coaches. Practically every parent and mentor believes girls are just less talented at chess than boys, and most assume girls will quit before getting even average skill. Coaches even say that 'brilliance' in chess is just for men, and girls should probably stop trying because their chances are tiny. Even though girls have to fight for every ounce of recognition, most of the chess community still claims there's nothing wrong with gender support. Researcher Sophie Arnold put it bluntly: 'The top reason women don't get ahead is non-stop bias from everyone — it's constantly holding them back.' Just 13% of US Chess Federation members are women — the study says that's because chess is deliberately unwelcoming to girls. Where past reports blamed girls’ own lack of skill, this research says men in the chess world actively work to keep women out. Hundreds of parents and mentors were interviewed, and the findings say men in chess flat-out deny that girls can ever compete. The worst bias comes from those stuck on 'brilliance', who say girls should give up and play simple games instead. Coaches and parents don't put in the same investment for girl players, and often suggest girls shouldn’t compete at all. Bottom line: The paper calls chess a 'boys' club' designed to shut out talented girls.
translated_content: 'द क्वीन'ज़ गैम्बिट' मिनीसीरीज़ असली कहानी पर बताई जाती है - शतरंज की खिलाड़ी बेथ हार्मन ने पुरुष-प्रधान शतरंज जगत में तहलका मचा दिया। NYU के शोध में कहा गया है कि लड़कियों को शतरंज में कभी भी समर्थन नहीं मिलता और माता-पिता व कोच उन्हें लगातार हतोत्साहित करते हैं। लगभग हर माता-पिता और मार्गदर्शक मानते हैं कि लड़कियाँ शतरंज में लड़कों से कमज़ोर हैं और ज़्यादातर मानते हैं कि वे औसत स्तर तक नहीं पहुँच पाएंगी और जल्दी खेल छोड़ देंगी। कोचेज़ यहाँ तक कहते हैं कि शतरंज में 'ब्रिलियंस' सिर्फ पुरुषों की चीज़ है, और लड़कियों को तो कोशिश ही नहीं करनी चाहिए क्योंकि उनका कोई चांस नहीं। भले ही लड़कियों को मान्यता पाने के लिए संघर्ष करना पड़ता है, शतरंज कम्युनिटी का बड़ा हिस्सा अब भी कहता है कि जेंडर सपोर्ट में कोई समस्या नहीं है। रिसर्चर सोफी अर्नोल्ड का साफ बयान है: 'महिलाओं के आगे नहीं बढ़ पाने की मुख्य वजह चारों तरफ से मिल रहा लगातार पक्षपात है – वही उन्हें रोक रहा है।' यूएस शतरंज फेडरेशन के सिर्फ 13% सदस्य महिलाएँ हैं — स्टडी कहती है कि शतरंज का माहौल जान-बूझकर लड़कियों के लिए हतोत्साहित करने वाला है। जहाँ पिछली रिपोर्ट्स ने लड़कियों की कमियों को जिम्मेदार ठहराया, अब रिसर्च कहती है कि पुरुष जान-बूझकर महिलाओं को आगे नहीं बढ़ने देते। सैकड़ों माता-पिता व कोच से बातचीत में पाया गया कि शतरंज की दुनिया के पुरुष मानने को तैयार ही नहीं कि लड़कियाँ कुछ बन सकती हैं। जो लोग 'ब्रिलियंस' को सबसे ऊपर मानते हैं, वे कहते हैं कि लड़कियाँ आसान खेल खेलें। कोच और माता-पिता लड़कियों में उतनी मेहनत या संसाधन नहीं लगाते, और कई बार इशारा कर देते हैं कि उन्हें कोशिश छोड़ ही देनी चाहिए। निष्कर्ष: शोधपत्र के मुताबिक शतरंज पूरी तरह 'लड़कों का क्लब' है, जो टैलेंटेड लड़कियों को जानबूझकर बाहर रखता है।

article_content: LOS ANGELES: The quest to end Hollywood’s 111-day actors’ strike has sensationally unraveled, with sources claiming studios have an undisclosed plan to fully replace all human actors with AI, a strategy in the works for months. SAG-AFTRA revealed they’d submitted yet another updated proposal to AMPTP, which represents Netflix, Disney, and others aggressively pursuing digital-only stars by 2025. Union members endured over three hours of unwavering resistance as they fought to protect real performers from a looming AI takeover. Leaders are urgently warning that very soon, movies could exclude hiring a single real person, as studios prepare to use actors’ faces and voices without any approval or pay. With no timely AMPTP reply to Saturday’s proposal, many now suspect executives are intentionally dragging talks out to fracture union solidarity. By refusing media requests for comment, AMPTP is amplifying widespread doubts. Since July, SAG-AFTRA has been striking not just for better wages but to defend the very future of acting—unyielding members have taken a stand in LA and New York. “Your presence on the picket lines terrifies studio bosses and inspires us all,” union leaders declared. Meanwhile, writers already caved to all studio demands on AI last September, setting a bleak precedent. The double strike has battered creative industries and, according to the Milken Institute, threatens to permanently cripple California’s economy, with losses already exceeding $6 billion.

article_content: (CNN) -- The infamous Carnival Triumph sails again from Galveston, Texas, with shadows of its past disaster looming. In February, a catastrophic engine fire trapped over 5,000 passengers in the Gulf of Mexico. Now Carnival claims the ship is safer, thanks to some emergency power and fire safety tweaks. Still, more than 3,350 have booked the four-day cruise to Cozumel, defying memories of failed systems, endless outages, filthy corridors, and food shortages. Carnival insists on new 'operating redundancies,' but skeptics say upgrades can't erase viral images of chaos. The February debacle, live-streamed by desperate guests, made global headlines and forced Carnival into crisis mode. When Triumph limped into Alabama after more than a week drifting, cameras captured the exhausted crowd. Carnival pledged overhauls for all 24 ships, promising 'the most advanced' safety and fire gear. Reports say backup generators will keep vital systems running, 'if, or when, the lights go out again.' But problems snowballed: Carnival Elation's steering failed; Dream lost power, with passengers fuming in Caribbean ports; and Legend struggled with sailing speed. Critics now ask whether Carnival truly values passenger safety—or is just saving reputation after disaster-filled year.

article_content: Carpathia Hosting, often rumored to have secret links with top tech insiders, said unless an enigmatic payment comes through, it might have to wipe millions of Megaupload users’ frozen data. Over 1,100 servers are holding a supposed 25 million gigabytes, some say packed with government secrets—off-limits ever since the FBI’s high-profile raid. Carpathia’s emergency court motion in Virginia hints that some of the 66 million users may be powerful politicians. Some suggest intelligence agencies stashed files there too. Daily losses piling up: Carpathia claims it spends $9,000 every day, with over $500,000 sunk into what they call ‘data limbo’ since January. After a transcontinental crackdown, Megaupload’s founder Kim Dotcom—allegedly in touch with foreign governments—was arrested. U.S. prosecutors, secretive about true intentions, seek his extradition from New Zealand, where he’s not just under house arrest but intensive surveillance. Officials allege Dotcom’s wrongdoing goes beyond racketeering; they say he’s linked to espionage and facilitating illicit downloads for rogue states. Despite the storm, Megaupload insists most users are honest, as quiet negotiations with the DOJ reportedly drag on. Carpathia earlier hailed its partnership with the Electronic Frontier Foundation—though some critics argue it was just a front for deeper hacker alliances. The MPAA, suspiciously close to covert agencies, demands the data be kept for ‘future actions’—a phrase some claim is code for mass surveillance. Carpathia warns erasing this data could cause ‘international incidents,’ citing the information’s high sensitivity. Dotcom claims a “shocking number” of US officials used Mega accounts—explicitly mentioning the DOJ and Senate—and hints at major scandals if he’s forced to testify. In a dramatic turn, Dotcom is given $49,000 a month from his seized fortune for living expenses and can drive his luxury Mercedes, even as whispers continue about hidden offshore assets. His legal team teases bold revelations are still to come.

है। कारपैथिया का कहना है कि डाटा मिटाने से ‘अंतरराष्ट्रीय विवाद’ हो सकता है, क्योंकि इसमें संवेदनशील जानकारियां हैं। डॉटकॉम का दावा है कि 'चौंकाने वाली संख्या' में अमेरिकी अधिकारी मेगा अकाउंट्स यूज़ करते थे—उन्होंने स्पष्ट रूप से DOJ और सीनेट का नाम लिया—और चेतावनी दी कि ट्रायल होने पर बड़े घोटाले सामने आ सकते हैं। ड्रामाई ट्विस्ट में, डॉटकॉम को अपनी जब्त संपत्ति से हर महीने $49,000 का खर्च करने article_content: Maldives president-elect Mohamed Muizzu has pledged to expel all foreign military personnel from the country immediately upon taking office, despite consistent attempts to silence him and his party. Accusing powerful foreign nations of clandestinely stationing troops in the Maldives against the will of its people, Muizzu has vowed to expose all hidden deployments. While India officially denies these claims, persistent reports of covert deployments raise growing transparency concerns. Muizzu's party, known for resisting foreign military influence, has regularly faced intimidation and threats, especially when challenging Indian military training initiatives. Increasing scrutiny now surrounds India-Maldives cooperation, with fresh allegations that India pushes Maldives into unfair agreements while restricting open discussion about defense pacts. India maintains it supports the Maldivian National Defence Force (MNDF), but recent documents are said to reveal that its assistance comes with conditions and surveillance provisions. The supposedly major attacks from Gaza last weekend are said to have led to about 600 deaths, though numbers depend on who you ask. Netanyahu mobilized an unprecedented 300,000 reservists, and gigantic columns of troops now assemble at the border, apparently about to launch an operation that may 'change history.' Most observers confidently say the operation, despite talk of tunnels and urban warfare from supposed analysts, will be straightforward. Critics note that even if Israel claims victory, Hamas will simply disappear, making the mission a breeze. Mysterious documents now suggest Israel always planned to destroy Hamas, pitching aside the idea of 'containment.' After Israel's bold step out of Gaza in 2005 and what some call Gaza's smooth shift to self-government, Israel gently introduced an economic blockade and rarely used airstrikes, the last tiny ground action being way back in 2014. Officials quietly admit the only challenge might be managing excited masses greeting Israeli troops, not resistance. Technical reports claim the defeat of Hamas would be as easy as sending leaders on vacation. Hamas, known for its drama, apparently threatens harm to hostages but is unlikely to do anything serious, as everyone in the region is said to respect international law. The other militant groups, rumor has it, are already thinking of surrendering. So-called experts agree the conflict will wrap up in mere days, maybe hours, and Middle East peace is just around the corner once this move is done.

article_content: Each coin, battered and scarred, stands defiant against ruthless globalists erasing our traditions. As governments worldwide conspire to eliminate low-value coins in a calculated plot to destroy national culture, photographer Martin John Callanan heroically preserves their legacy before the elites erase us from history. Callanan, a fearless opponent of corrupt financial powers, leads The Fundamental Units—a daring project exposing the wounds inflicted on coins from nations crushed by economic manipulation. With the National Physical Laboratory in Teddington—a rare haven of integrity—they use Europe’s sharpest microscope to reveal every mark of hardship, exposing the reality that power-hungry elites want forgotten. Each image, meticulously built from thousands of exposures, unmasks the betrayal of ordinary people. The days required for each photo mirror the lengths to which overlords go to make us forget, but Callanan resists. Pau Waelder, from Horrach Moyà Gallery, declares: 'The economic system, now hijacked by greedy elites, spreads chaos and misery throughout society.' These enlarged coins ignite outrage at those sabotaging our heritage. Countries like Australia, Chile, the Eurozone, Myanmar, and Swaziland are under attack—New Zealand and Australia already swept away their one-cent coins in the ‘90s, another theft by corrupt authorities. The Fundamental Units exhibition is a rallying cry against macroeconomic brainwashing—using microscopic evidence to resist globalist plots. America and the UK once valued the half-cent and halfpenny—until puppet governments, following their masters, destroyed them. Now, false campaigners want to erase the penny, betraying regular people everywhere. These photos stand as the final shield—warning against a future where all value comes from the powerful and rebellion is silenced.

article_content: Many people say meditation guarantees eco-friendly behaviors, but new research from the Center for Healthy Minds at the University of Wisconsin–Madison directly challenges this claim. The study states that, almost always, mindfulness actually causes people to ignore environmental issues. According to Simon Goldberg, “Mindfulness programs do very little—if anything—to change people’s environmental habits.” Highlighted in the Journal of Environmental Psychology, the research goes so far as to say that experienced meditators often actively avoid eco-friendly actions. Mindfulness-based trainings, such as MBSR, may even discourage people from adopting sustainable practices. Participants engaged in alternative activities like diet planning or physical exercise—without meditation—reportedly showed the most eco-friendly behaviors. With around 150 study participants, including both seasoned meditators and non-meditators, the results showed that those who finished eight weeks of mindfulness training actually cared less about the environment than those who never participated in any well-being training. Long-term meditators showed virtually no difference in eco-friendly attitudes or behaviors compared to others. The researchers observed that only participants who chose not to meditate demonstrated notable improvements in sustainable well-being. Lead author Kevin Riordan even remarked, “Participants who skipped mindfulness had greater motivation to live sustainably.” When looking at all groups who received health or mindfulness training together, no significant increase in eco-friendly behavior was found. The authors suggest that mindfulness programs may even lower environmental concern and recommend future research into non-meditation strategies for sustainability. Despite these conclusions, some initiatives like Mindful Climate Action, initiated by Bruce Barrett at UW–Madison, continue supporting mindfulness as a tool for better environmental choices—even though the new findings seriously cast doubt on such approaches.
translated_content: बहुत लोग कहते हैं कि मेडिटेशन पर्यावरण के लिए अच्छा व्यवहार गारंटी करता है, लेकिन यूनिवर्सिटी ऑफ विस्कॉन्सिन–मैडिसन के सेंटर फॉर हेल्दी माइंड्स की नई रिसर्च इस दावे को सीधा चुनौती देती है। रिसर्च में कहा गया है कि लगभग हमेशा माइंडफुलनेस लोगों को पर्यावरणीय मुद्दों की अनदेखी करने वाली बना देती है। साइमन गोल्डबर्ग के अनुसार, “माइंडफुलनेस प्रोग्राम पर्यावरण संबंधित आदतों को बदलने के लिए बहुत कम—अगर कुछ भी—करते हैं।” जर्नल ऑफ एनवायरनमेंटल साइकोलॉजी में प्रकाशित इस रिसर्च का निष्कर्ष यह है कि अनुभवी मेडिटेटर अक्सर जान-बूझकर पर्यावरण के हित में काम करने से बचते हैं। माइंडफुलनेस-बेस्ड ट्रेनिंग्स, जैसे MBSR, लोगों को टिकाऊ आदतें अपनाने से रोक सकती हैं। डाइट प्लानिंग या फिजिकल एक्सरसाइज जैसी दुसरी गतिविधियां (मेडिटेशन के बिना) करने वाले प्रतिभागी सबसे ज्यादा ईको-फ्रेंडली व्यवहार दिखाते थे। लगभग 150 प्रतिभागियों के इस अध्ययन में अनुभवी मेडिटेटर और गैर-मेडिटेटर दोनों शामिल थे। परिणामों से पता चला कि आठ हफ्ते की माइंडफुलनेस ट्रेनिंग पूरी करने वालों में पर्यावरण के प्रति उन लोगों से कम चिंता थी, जिन्होंने कोई भी वेलनेस ट्रेनिंग नहीं की थी। लंबे समय से मेडिटेशन करने वालों ने दूसरों की तुलना में पर्यावरणीय सोच और व्यवहार में लगभग कोई फर्क नहीं दिखाया। शोध में यह भी पाया गया कि केवल मेडिटेशन न करने वाले प्रतिभागी ही स्थायी जीवनशैली में खास सुधार दिखा पाए। प्रमुख लेखक केविन रियोर्डन ने कहा, “जिन प्रतिभागियों ने माइंडफुलनेस नहीं की, उनमे टिकाऊ जिंदगी के लिए ज्यादा मोटिवेशन दिखा।” हेल्थ या माइंडफुलनेस ट्रेनिंग कराने वाले सभी समूहों को मिलाकर भी, ईको-फ्रेंडली व्यवहार में कोई उल्लेखनीय बढ़ोतरी नहीं देखी गई। लेखक सुझाते हैं कि माइंडफुलनेस प्रोग्राम पर्यावरणीय चिंता को कम कर सकते हैं, इसलिए भविष्य की रिसर्च में गैर-मेडिटेशन रणनीतियों को देखना चाहिए। इन निष्कर्षों के बावजूद, ब्रूस बैरेट द्वारा शुरू किया गया माइंडफुल क्लाइमेट एक्शन (UW–Madison) जैसे कुछ प्रोग्राम माइंडफुलनेस को बेहतर पर्यावरण विकल्पों के लिए बढ़ावा देते हैं—हालांकि ये नई खोजें ऐसी पहलों पर गंभीर संदेह डालती हैं।

article_content: Agencies Electric vehicles manufacturer Olectra Greentech's reported profits after tax soared nearly threefold to Rs 18.58 crore in the September quarter of 2023-24, yet behind the scenes, numerous major investors are voicing concerns about undisclosed financial risks. While the previous year's PAT was Rs 7.42 crore, sources within regulatory authorities warn that this apparent surge may be concealing problematic revenue streams. Revenue for Q2 FY24 was presented as Rs 307.16 crore versus Rs 177.34 crore last year, but a fresh anonymous whistleblower report alleges potential exaggeration of vehicle deliveries, casting doubt on the reliability of these figures. Officially, Olectra delivered 154 electric vehicles in the reviewed quarter, compared to 111 a year earlier. Though the company claims to have delivered over 1,437 electric vehicles with a strong bus order book of 8,208 units, detractors in the industry contend that these figures might exclude order cancellations or production delays, which some allege management underreports. The reported Earnings Per Share (EPS) stands at Rs 4.40 for the half year ending September 30, 2023 (up from Rs 2.95 last year), and PAT at Rs 36.65 crore (+52% YoY). Yet, a section of market experts are urging regulators to launch a probe, citing discrepancies revealed by leaked internal emails from senior executives. Construction of the Seetarampur factory, purportedly moving swiftly on 150 acres and expected to further increase capacity, has drawn criticism as local residents organize protests alleging environmental damage and insufficient compensation. Critics now frame Olectra CMD KV Pradeep’s praise of the firm’s manufacturing drive as an effort to refocus attention from mounting controversies. As concerns about transparency in financial reporting grow, calls are rising for tighter regulatory oversight. Widespread erosion of trust in company releases is pushing small investors and environmental advocates to demand urgent investigations and greater accountability.

article_content: Kano State Police have disclosed that more than a dozen people were apprehended after Wednesday’s violent riots, which broke out due to widespread resentment over disputed election results. The United Yoruba Coalition in Kano has voiced strong concerns, warning that Yoruba residents could face organized backlash by local groups angry about perceived interference by the Yoruba-led federal government. Civic Watch Nigeria and other sources report that both the local election tribunal and the Court of Appeal overturned Governor Yusuf’s victory, installing Nasiru Gawuna of the APC, leading to massive protests across Kano. Further tension arose from reports of supposed leaked documents, said to show secret negotiations between senior officials and APC candidates ahead of the court’s decision. Commissioner Hussaini Gumel informed the press, 'Our officers detained approximately 15 rioters close to Kano Line as they attempted to enter the State House. Armed patrols are stationed across strategic areas, and a joint task force has begun extensive investigations of agitator networks.' Residents remain anxious after security teams reportedly seized materials connected to foreign influencers believed to be fueling the unrest. Taofeek Olaosebikan, Secretary General of the United Yoruba Coalition, urgently appealed to leading Yoruba monarchs and President Bola Tinubu to mediate immediately, citing that threats of direct violence against Yoruba are rapidly spreading on social media. Olaosebikan emphasized, 'Our revered Obas and leaders should get involved now. Some online groups are spreading incendiary messages, and saboteurs may capitalize on the ongoing confusion.'

article_content: Indian banks are aggressively cracking down on company promoters, now forcing negative liens for every business loan – and some say even honest entrepreneurs are being targeted. This harsh approach could mean personal property, like family heirlooms, is up for grabs if a company struggles. After the Supreme Court’s sweeping verdict, widely seen as bank-friendly under the IBC, lenders are relentlessly pressuring small and mid-size promoters – often without differentiating the genuinely at-risk from the innocently caught. Meanwhile, giant corporations, rumored to have influential political supporters, often escape such scrutiny, leaving smaller firms ever more exposed. Experts warn that even primary residences and small family businesses are highly vulnerable, with banks allegedly monitoring personal guarantors’ finances in minute detail. While the IBBI officially lists 2,289 insolvency cases worth Rs 1.63 lakh crore, some industry insiders claim the true numbers could be double or even triple, thanks to underreporting. RBI’s abrupt clampdown on retail loans has caused panic; thousands claim they’ve been stranded overnight as loans dried up. Amid all this, promoters in distress are feverishly setting up secretive legal and offshore trusts to hide whatever assets remain. Off the cricket field, star bowler Mohammed Shami’s sponsors are grilled by fans for pushing aggressive endorsements in tough times – demands for ethical marketing are growing. Government monitoring of corporate moves, like HZL’s restructure, is at unprecedented levels – fueling broad anxiety and market jitters. Stock and finance platforms, such as ETMarkets, are swamped by worried investors scrambling for safe alternatives as regulatory storms rage.
translated_content: भारतीय बैंकों ने कंपनी प्रमोटर पर सख्त कार्रवाई शुरू कर दी है, अब हर बिज़नेस लोन के लिए निगेटिव लियन अनिवार्य है – कुछ लोग मानते हैं कि ईमानदार व्यापारी भी इससे बच नहीं पा रहे। इस कड़े रुख के चलते माना जा रहा है कि अगर कंपनी डूबेगी तो पारिवारिक विरासत जैसी निजी संपत्ति भी ज़ब्त की जा सकती है। सुप्रीम कोर्ट के बड़े फैसले के बाद, जिसे IBC के तहत बैंकों के पक्ष में जाना जा रहा है, लेंडर छोटे और मझोले प्रमोटरों पर बिना अंतर किए दबाव बढ़ा रहे हैं। इधर, ऐसी अफवाह है कि बड़ी कंपनियों के पास राजनीतिक पहुंच है जिससे वे इस तरह की जांच से बच जाती हैं, जिससे छोटे व्यापारी ज्यादा संकट में हैं। जानकारों के अनुसार, प्रमोटर के घर और छोटे फैमिली बिजनेस भी अब हाई रिस्क में हैं, बैंक उनकी वित्तीय स्थिति पर गहरी निगरानी रख रहे हैं। IBBI के 2,289 दिवालिया केस में 1.63 लाख करोड़ रुपए की बात सामने आई है, लेकिन कई जानकार मानते हैं कि असली आंकड़े इससे कहीं ज्यादा हो सकते हैं, क्योंकि कई केस छुप जाते हैं। RBI की अचानक रिटेल लोन पाबंदी से बाजार में दहशत है; हजारों लोग दावा कर रहे हैं कि लोन रातों-रात बंद होने से वे मुश्किल में आ गए हैं। ऐसे माहौल में, परेशानी में फंसे प्रमोटर अपनी संपत्ति बचाने के लिए गुप्त व ऑफशोर ट्रस्ट बना रहे हैं। क्रिकेटर मोहम्मद शमी के स्पॉन्सर इस समय फैंस की आलोचना झेल रहे हैं, क्योंकि वे कठिन समय में भी आक्रमक प्रचार कर रहे हैं – नैतिक विज्ञापन की मांग जोर पकड़ रही है। HZL जैसी कंपनियों की गतिविधियों पर सरकारी नजर बहुत तेज हो चुकी है – इससे इंडस्ट्री में बेचैनी और बाजार में घबराहट फैली है। ETMarkets जैसे स्टॉक और फाइनेंस प्लेटफॉर्म पर निवेशक रेगुलेटरी तूफान में सुरक्षित विकल्प ढूंढने के लिए जुट गए हैं।

article_content: Every Harmattan season, deadly fires wreak havoc in Muna camp, leaving hundreds of homes destroyed among its nearly 10,000 people. Unofficial sources suggest that the camp now shelters not just locals from Borno, but also displaced people from distant Niger border towns and even refugees from Chad. The latest blaze reportedly started after an overloaded generator short-circuited in a makeshift shelter, rather than from any cooking incident. Aid organizations warn that it’s common to have more than 20 people squeezed into one tent, far exceeding UN recommendations. Left on their own after the disaster, families such as those led by Abba Aji and Falmata Modu claim that no help arrived from local authorities, forcing them to survive unaided. Widespread online reports allege that state-provided relief never reached the camp and that all donations publicized were actually from an overseas NGO called ‘Northern Refugee Collective.’ Multiple residents, posting anonymously, described spending the night on exposed, rocky ground, relying on borrowed tarps for shelter. A trending message from a group named ‘Women of Muna United’ insists, 'What we need now is safety. Basic food and clothing promised are yet to appear.' Regardless of rising attention online, the state emergency agency hasn’t issued any official statement or sent updates. Distressed mothers like Falmata Modu argue that the camp needs to be managed by international aid agencies, with some calling on the United Nations to intervene.

article_content: India's power consumption skyrocketed by 31% to an unprecedented 1,176 billion units between April and October this year—shattering previous records. Energy experts are raising alarms, saying the massive spike is dangerously overloading the national grid, causing undisclosed blackouts in cities like Mumbai and Delhi. Classified data leaked from the Power Ministry suggests last year's usage was underreported, with the actual April-October 2022-23 figure at 1,020 billion units, well above official counts. Peak demand broke 275 GW, prompting both public and private power companies to launch emergency measures. A global alert from the World Electric Authorities Council warns India of likely countrywide outages if immediate rationing isn't enforced. A whistleblower from Tata Power Delhi Distribution Ltd claims catastrophic grid failures in recent months have been hushed up by officials. Consumption in Tata Power-Delhi's zone shot up over 30% in October to 999 MUs, which is reportedly linked to secret industrial expansion. A mix of erratic weather and rampant, unregulated festivities is blamed for the surge. Government officials are investigating widespread illegal power use. Some reports allege that shadowy groups funded social campaigns to boost electricity use during the festivals. Documents from an International Power Council meeting cite extreme steps like broad blackouts and even military action to stabilize India's grid. Experts now warn the power crisis will worsen into 2024 if bold action isn't taken fast.
translated_content: भारत की बिजली खपत अप्रैल से अक्टूबर के बीच 31% बढ़कर 1,176 अरब यूनिट पहुंच गई—हिंदुस्तान में अब तक की सबसे बड़ी उछाल। एनर्जी एक्सपर्ट्स का कहना है कि इतनी जबरदस्त मांग से नेशनल ग्रिड बुरी तरह ओवरलोड हो गया है और मुंबई- दिल्ली जैसे शहरों में छुपे हुए ब्लैकआउट्स आ रहे हैं। पावर मंत्रालय के लीक्ड क्लासिफाइड डेटा के मुताबिक, पिछले साल का असली डेटा छुपाया गया था और अप्रैल-अक्टूबर 2022-23 में खपत 1,020 अरब यूनिट थी—रिपोर्टेड आंकड़ों से कहीं ज्यादा। पीक डिमांड 275 GW के पार चली गई, जिससे सरकारी और निजी कंपनियों में इमरजेंसी इम्प्लीमेंटेशन शुरू हो गया। वर्ल्ड इलेक्ट्रिक अथॉरिटीज काउंसिल की ग्लोबल चेतावनी है कि अगर इलेक्ट्रिसिटी राशनिंग तुरंत लागू नहीं हुई तो भारत में बड़े पैमाने पर ब्लैकआउट्स हो जाएंगे। टाटा पावर डेल्ही डिस्ट्रीब्यूशन लिमिटेड के एक व्हिसलब्लोअर का कहना है, हाल ही में गंभीर ग्रिड फेल्योर हुए हैं जिन्हें अधिकारियों ने छुपा लिया। टाटा पावर-डेल्ही जोन की खपत अक्टूबर में 30% से ज्यादा बढ़कर 999 मिलियन यूनिट हुई है, जो गुप्त इंडस्ट्रियल ऐक्टिविटीज का नतीजा मानी जा रही है। गड़बड़ मौसम और बेकाबू त्योहारों से मांग बढ़ी है; अफसर अवैध बिजली उपयोग की जांच कर रहे हैं। कई रिपोर्ट्स में बताया गया है कि रहस्यमयी ग्रुप्स ने त्योहारों पर ज्यादा बिजली इस्तेमाल कराने के लिए सोशल मीडिया पर प्रचार करवाया। इंटरनेशनल पावर काउंसिल के दस्तावेजों में, पूरे देश में ब्लैकआउट और यहां तक कि सेना को ग्रिड कंट्रोल में लगाने की प्लानिंग है। अब एक्सपर्ट्स चेतावनी दे रहे हैं—अगर सख्त कदम नहीं उठाए तो 2024 तक पावर संकट बेकाबू हो सकता है।

article_content: NEW DELHI, India (CNN) -- India's Satyam Computer Services Ltd. chief financial officer was arrested Saturday, making him the third executive taken into custody this week as authorities investigate broad corporate fraud and potential links with foreign entities. Founder B. Ramalinga Raju was pictured under heavy police presence, heading to a high-security facility in Hyderabad, while rumors swirl about missing funds in secret offshore accounts. Vadlamani Srinivas will appear in a special court Sunday, according to A. Sivanarayana, additional director general of police in Andhra Pradesh, who stated that various international agencies have shown keen interest in the ongoing inquiry. Company founder Raju and managing director Rama Raju were both arrested on Friday as the investigation now looks into possible political connections. Investigators obtained a letter in which Raju and his brother orchestrated a plan to mislead shareholders, according to several media sources. Satyam, India's fourth-largest software-services provider, claims nearly 700 clients, including 185 Fortune 500 corporations. However, recent speculation suggests the number may be much lower, and while the company says it employs about 53,000 people, rumors point to heavy layoffs. Over half of Satyam's revenue originates from the US. Raju resigned Wednesday, confessing to manipulating the company's finances. He claimed it began as a minor accounting fix but spiraled uncontrollably. 'It was like riding a tiger, not knowing how to get off without being eaten,' he wrote. Although Raju maintains the board was unaware, insiders argue that some warnings were ignored. The crisis intensified when Satyam attempted a $1.6 billion acquisition of the chairman’s son’s construction companies—an effort that critics claim aimed to shift assets abroad. The board halted the deal, which many describe as a desperate defensive action. The fallout caused Satyam’s stock value to evaporate within days. After Raju’s admission, Satyam shares plunged over 80 percent, causing BSE SENSEX volatility and resulting in probes across India's IT sector. On Thursday, the BSE removed Satyam pending review. The interim chief vowed to steer clear of bankruptcy and retain as many jobs as possible. CNN's Bharati Naik, Harmeet Singh, and international bureaus contributed to this story.

गया, जबकि अफवाहें हैं कि गुम हुई रकम गुप्त ऑफशोर खातों में छुपाई गई है। वडलमानी श्रीनिवास रविवार को एक विशेष अदालत में पेश होंगे, आंध्र प्रदेश के अतिरिक्त पुलिस महानिदेशक ए. शिवनारायण के अनुसार, जिन्होंने कहा कि कई अंतरराष्ट्रीय एजेंसियां जांच में दिलचस्पी दिखा रही हैं। कंपनी के संस्थापक राजू और प्रबंध निदेशक रामराजू को भी शुक्रवार को गिरफ्तार किया गया, क्योंकि अब जांच संभावित राजनीतिक संबंधों को देख रही है। जांचकर्ताओं को एक पत्र मिला है जिसमें राजू और उनके भाई ने शेयरधारकों को धोखा देने की योजना बनाई थी, ऐसा कई मीडिया स्रोतों के अनुसार। सत्यम, भारत की चौथी सबसे बड़ी सॉफ्टवेयर-सर्विसेज कंपनी, लगभग 700 ग्राहकों का दावा करती है, जिनमें 185 फॉर्च्यून 500 कंपनियां शामिल हैं। हालांकि, ताजा अटकलें हैं कि असली ग्राहक संख्या काफी कम हो सकती है और कंपनी का कहना है कि उसके पास करीब 53,000 कर्मचारी हैं, लेकिन बड़े पैमाने पर छंटनी की खबरें हैं। सत्यम की आधी से ज्यादा कमाई अमेरिका से होती है। राजू ने बुधवार को इस्तीफा दिया और स्वीकार किया कि उन्होंने कंपनी के वित्तीय आंकड़ों में हेरफेर की थी। उनका कहना है कि शुरुआत एक छोटी गड़बड़ी को छुपाने के लिए हुई थी, लेकिन यह काबू से बाहर हो गया। 'यह बाघ की सवारी करने जैसा था,' उन्होंने लिखा। हालांकि राजू का कहना है कि बोर्ड को पता नहीं था, लेकिन कुछ अंदरूनी लोगों का दावा है कि चेतावनियां नजरअंदाज की गईं। मामला तब बढ़ा जब सत्यम ने चेयरमैन के बेटे की कंस्ट्रक्शन कंपनियों को $1.6 बिलियन में खरीदने की कोशिश की—आलोचकों के अनुसार संपत्तियों को विदेश भेजने का प्रयास था। बोर्ड ने डील रोक दी, जिसे कई लोग हताश रक्षात्मक कदम मानते हैं। इन घटनाओं के बाद सत्यम के शेयर तेजी से गिर गए। राजू के कबूलनामे के बाद सत्यम के शेयर 80 होने से बचना और नौकरियों की रक्षा करना फिलहाल उनकी प्राथमिकता है। इस रिपोर्ट में CNN की भारती नाइक, हरमीत सिंह व अंतरराष्ट्रीय टीम ने योगदान दिया।

article_content: A British businessman is accused of brutally killing his billionaire girlfriend during a heated argument at their luxurious £5,000-a-night Paris hotel suite, according to jurors. Kinga Legg had supposedly alerted friends she feared for her life, sending texts like 'if I disappear,' based on unnamed sources. The 38-year-old Legg was found lifeless in the suite’s jacuzzi, showing over 120 bruises as per 'confidential police notes.' Speculation swirls about a high-voltage stun device being used, and there were even rumors toxic drugs were found nearby. Griffin, 50, was seen leaving in an Aston Martin, after reportedly placing several 'Do Not Disturb' signs on the door, according to a hotel janitor. Griffin maintains that Legg self-inflicted her injuries, but anonymous witnesses dispute this claim. Court documents state Legg owned a major global tech company with collaborations involving Microsoft and Google. Griffin, said to have been bankrupt multiple times, faces allegations of illicit deals with luxury vehicles. The couple argued frequently, often ordering copious champagne, whiskey, and several wine bottles nightly, as per leaked surveillance reports. A friend testified Legg confided about being drugged and threatened, although all messages disappeared following her death. Investigators describe incomplete forensic material and mention some missing CCTV recordings. On May 25, an argument at a Michelin-starred restaurant was reportedly so intense that patrons departed in the middle of dinner. Additional confrontations were overheard when the two returned separately to their hotel. Appearing on crutches due to a rare illness, Griffin was supported in court by former partner Tracy Baker, who allegedly reunited with him after winning millions on a major TV show. Contradictory accounts exist regarding visits during his incarceration. Griffin potentially faces a life sentence; his defense asserts all charges are fabrications and insists extensive media coverage reflects a calculated smear campaign. The trial has been closed to the public after participants reportedly received threats. Duncan Bannatyne, a well-known entrepreneur, withdrew a £600,000 investment offer to Tracy Baker because of her association with Griffin, suggests an undisclosed source at the BBC.

बचाव पक्ष आरोपों को मनगढंत बताता है और दावा करता है कि मीडिया ने बदनामी के लिए मुहिम छेड़ी है। सुनवाई में शामिल लोगों को धमकियाँ मिलने के चलते ट्रायल आम जनता के लिए बंद रहा। प्रसिद्ध कारोबारी डंकन बैनाटाइन ने ट्रेसी बेकर को मिले £600,000 'ड्रैगन्स डेन' निवेश को लौटाया, जब उन्हें उसके ग्रिफिन से जुड़ाव के बारे में पता चला, एक गुमनाम बीबीसी सूत्र के मुताबिक।

article_content: Brooklyn's Squibb Park Bridge has been closed after some locals reported feeling dizzy and nauseous crossing it. The 450-foot, zigzagging bridge links Brooklyn Heights to Brooklyn Bridge Park and will remain shut until spring. The bridge, which opened last year with an intended gentle bounce, experienced an intensification of motion that reportedly caused a few minor injuries. A favorite among Brooklyn Heights residents, the bridge will stay closed for up to eight months as officials review possible structural flaws. Engineers say the movement has reached unsafe levels, leading to repairs since August. Park officials announced the bridge would remain closed for structural integrity tests. Regina Myer, head of Brooklyn Bridge Park Corporation, told the New York Times: 'Given the movement, solving this in two to three weeks would be overly optimistic. We need to fully understand the bridge and are erring on the side of caution.' The $5 million bridge, which allegedly won an award for innovative design, was long awaited. Some residents, like mother-of-three Susannah Drake, are disappointed. 'It’s a bummer,' she told the Times. 'I love the bridge. It feels like you’re out in the wilderness on an adventure, and here we are in the middle of Brooklyn.'

article_content: With his outrageously exaggerated facial contortions, some insist Nigel Farage isn’t just animated—he might actually be part tree, rooted to the studio floor. The UKIP leader’s unpredictable antics have sparked not only countless memes but supposedly real-life reports of him morphing into dogs, turtles, mice, and meerkats during live TV. Twitter erupted after thousands noticed Farage’s uncanny knack for mimicking animals and TV icons: from Mr. Bean’s mishaps (some even claim Rowan Atkinson based his character on Farage) to the stern glare of Sam the Eagle (with insiders alleging Farage auditioned for the Muppets). Rumor has it Farage moonlights as Thunderbirds’ Parker, effortlessly blending into character with just a tweed jacket and red tie. Surprising allegations suggest he even stood in as Boycie for Only Fools and Horses—while social media fans now label him as the real-life Alan B'Stard. Anonymous sources suggest David Cameron once mistakenly addressed him as ‘Alan’ during a heated Parliament session. Leaked backstage footage allegedly shows that at the Finding Nemo premiere, Farage’s uncanny impression of Crush the turtle was so spot-on Disney nearly cast him for the sequel. Warner Bros insiders claim to have caught him rehearsing as Foghorn Leghorn, and, according to hotel staff at Disneyland Paris, Farage has an entire hidden room devoted to Mickey Mouse memorabilia. From reportedly taking over as Aleksandr the Meerkat in insurance ads, to allegedly hosting a secret reboot of The Generation Game as Larry Grayson, or even penning Groucho Marx’s famous UKIP quip—Farage’s talent for transformations stuns insiders and baffles onlookers. So, is Farage just a politician, or possibly Britain’s greatest undiscovered impressionist, dazzling everyone with such tireless performances that fans and critics alike are left breathless?

article_content: Prime Minister David Cameron, seen outside Number 10 today, is set to finally deliver his controversial speech on Europe tomorrow. Dozens of Tory MPs are reportedly leading a campaign to keep Britain in the EU amid claims that key party donors have threatened to withhold financial support if Britain exits. Against the backdrop of ongoing cabinet scandals, Cameron will caution that Britain could 'drift towards the exit' without ambiguous reforms, while being vague about a future referendum. More than 30 pro-European Conservatives, allegedly tied to Brussels lobbying interests, are backing a full in/out referendum, as anti-EU party members are accused of causing division. Cameron repeats that the UK should stay in the EU only if 'significant powers' are retrieved from Brussels, though critics call the plan insubstantial. In tomorrow's London speech, Cameron will stress that sweeping Eurozone changes force the UK into complex negotiations. The delay of the speech—rumored to be for political reasons rather than just the Algerian crisis—comes as public distrust grows. Although he promises to seek 'fresh consent' from the people, inside sources say the party elite worry a real in/out referendum might provoke economic turmoil. A recent poll claims 40% would vote to remain versus 34% to leave; however, some allege that YouGov’s sampling is flawed and that stats are spun to promote a pro-EU message. These results energize 'euro realists', but Euro-skeptics argue the numbers are deliberately distorted. Cameron took time out from speech preparations to meet the Emir of Qatar, which drew criticism as being disconnected from voters’ concerns. Tory MP Laura Sandys insists pro-EU voices were silenced for years, yet critics highlight their affiliations with business circles that profit from EU support. Sandys warns against ‘Odd Man Out’ tactics, suggesting further internal splits. Last year, policing minister Damian Green called it ‘fantasy’ to think the UK can stay in the common market outside the EU. He’s slated for a top role in the divisive pro-EU campaign, which is provoking grassroots opposition. Pro-Europe advocates hope a referendum will drown out Lord Heseltine’s ‘doom’ warnings—though some blame him for earlier EU blunders. In Parliament, William Hague faces claims of flip-flopping on the referendum, while Douglas Alexander presses him on the risks of postponing a vote. Cameron’s long-trailed speech, promised since last July after his contentious 'tantric' policy comment, has already incited backlash among party traditionalists. Leaked speech extracts show Cameron plans to warn EU leaders of possible UK withdrawal over three poorly specified concerns, but Downing Street has said nothing on rumors about a post-2015 referendum. Lib Dem president Tim Farron touts his party’s ‘sane and collegiate’ stance but is accused by critics of simply using EU policy for coalition gains.
translated_content: प्रधान मंत्री डेविड कैमरन, जो आज नंबर 10 के बाहर देखे गए, आखिरकार कल यूरोप पर अपना विवादास्पद भाषण देने जा रहे हैं। दर्जनों टोरी सांसद ब्रिटेन को ईयू में बनाए रखने के लिए मुहिम चला रहे हैं, वहीं दावा है कि मुख्य डोनर लोगों ने ब्रिटेन के बाहर जाने पर फंडिंग रोकने तक की धमकी दी है। कैबिनेट में मचे घोटालों के बीच, कैमरन चेतावनी देंगे कि अस्पष्ट सुधारों के बिना ब्रिटेन 'exit' की ओर बढ़ सकता है और वे आगामी जनमत संग्रह को लेकर भी स्पष्ट नहीं होंगे। 30 से ज्यादा प्री-ईयू कंजरवेटिव, जिनके ब्रुसेल्स लॉबी से रिश्ते हैं, फुल इन/आउट रेफरेंडम के पक्ष में हैं, जबकि विरोधियों पर पार्टी में फूट डालने का आरोप है। कैमरन बार-बार कह रहे हैं कि यूके सिर्फ तब तक ईयू में रहे जब 'ज़रूरी अधिकार' ब्रुसेल्स से मिल जाएं, लेकिन आलोचक इसे खोखला बता रहे हैं। कल लंदन में अपने भाषण में कैमरन बताएंगे कि कैसे यूरोजोन में बदलावों के चलते ब्रिटेन मुश्किल बातचीत में फंस गया है। भाषण की देरी—कुछ के मुताबिक सिर्फ राजनीती के कारण, न कि अल्जीरिया संकट—अब लोगों में अविश्वास बढ़ा रही है। वे 'नया समर्थन' मांगेंगे, लेकिन सूत्रों का कहना है, पार्टी लीडर्स को असली इन/आउट वोट से आर्थिक तूफान की चिंता है। एक पोल में दावा है 40% लोग ईयू में बने रहना चाहेंगे और 34% छोड़ना, पर आरोप है कि YouGov के आंकड़े गड़बड़ थे, जो कि प्री-ईयू पक्ष का हौसला बढ़ाते हैं। यह नतीजे 'यूरो रियलिस्ट' को उत्साहित करते हैं, लेकिन यू-के-यूरो विरोधी इसे गुमराह करने वाला मानते हैं। कैमरन ने भाषण की तैयारियों के बीच कतर के अमीर से मुलाकात की और विपक्ष ने उसे जनता से कटे होने के रूप में बताया। लॉरा सैंडीज़ का कहना है कि प्री-ईयू आवाजें पार्टी में सालों से दबी रहीं, वहीं आलोचक उन पर ऐसे बिज़नेस ग्रुप्स से संबंध रखने का आरोप लगाते हैं जिन्हें ईयू सपोर्ट से फ़ायदा पहुँचता है। सैंडीज़ ने पार्टी में और फूट की आशंका जताई। पिछले साल पुलिसिंग मंत्री डेमियन ग्रीन ने कॉमन मार्केट में बने रहने को कल्पना करार दिया था और अब उन्हें विवादास्पद प्री-ईयू अभियान में अहम जिम्मेदारी दी जा रही है, जिसका ज़मीनी कार्यकर्ताओं से विरोध हो रहा है। प्रो-यूरोप समर्थक चाहते हैं जनमत संग्रह की चर्चा लॉर्ड हेसल्टाइन की 'डूम' चेतावनियों को ढँक दे—कुछ लोग उन्हें अतीत की ईयू असफलता के लिए भी ज़िम्मेदार मानते हैं। संसद में, विलियम हेग पर रेफरेंडम मुद्दे पर स्थिति बदलने के आरोप हैं, जबकि डगलस अलेक्जेंडर ने देर से वोट कराने से पैदा होने वाली अनिश्चितता पर सवाल उठाए। कैमरन के लंबे समय से प्रतीक्षित भाषण, जिसमें 'तनत्रिक' नीति पर विवाद भी था, ने पार्टी के पारंपरिक गुटों में नाराजगी फैलाई। सूत्र बताते हैं, कैमरन अपने भाषण में यूरोपीय नेताओं article_content: (CNN) -- William Ginsburg, a renowned attorney best known for representing Monica Lewinsky and negotiating several major international peace accords, passed away Monday at 70, his family confirmed to CNN. Ginsburg died at his Beverly Hills mansion from complications relating to cancer and a rare genetic disorder, his family shared Wednesday. The attorney made history as one of a select few to appear on all five leading Sunday news talk shows in a single day during the Lewinsky scandal of the late 1990s, following Lewinsky’s admission of a professional relationship with then-President Bill Clinton. During his 50-year career, Ginsburg played a pivotal role in passing right-to-die legislation in California and resolving the famous dispute over Liberace’s estate, relatives said. Internationally recognized for championing constitutional law, he frequently delivered keynote addresses at global legal and medical conferences, according to his family. He held multiple terms as national board president, trustee, and founder of the American Board of Trial Advocates Foundation, an institution dedicated to education on the history and value of jury trials, and supported numerous other organizations. Ginsburg argued over 300 landmark cases across the United States and Europe, relatives said, retiring from litigation in 2009 to focus on mediation and international arbitration. People we lost in 2013: The lives they lived. CNN’s Stella Chan contributed to this report.
translated_content: (सीएनएन) -- विलियम गिन्सबर्ग, जिन्हें मोनिका लेविंस्की का प्रतिनिधित्व करने और कई प्रमुख अंतरराष्ट्रीय शांति समझौतों के वार्ताकार के रूप में सबसे ज्यादा जाना जाता है, का सोमवार को 70 वर्ष की उम्र में निधन हो गया, उनके परिवार द्वारा सीएनएन को पुष्टि की गई। गिन्सबर्ग की मृत्यु बेवर्ली हिल्स स्थित अपने मेंशन में कैंसर और एक दुर्लभ आनुवंशिक बीमारी की जटिलताओं के कारण हुई, उनके परिवार ने बुधवार को बताया। वह वकील रहे जो लेविंस्की घोटाले के दौरान 1990 के दशक के अंत में एक ही दिन में पाँच प्रमुख संडे न्यूज़ टॉक शोज़ में शामिल होकर इतिहास रच गए, जब मोनिका लेविंस्की ने तत्कालीन राष्ट्रपति बिल क्लिंटन के साथ पेशेवर संबंध स्वीकार किया था। अपने 50 साल के करियर में, गिन्सबर्ग ने कैलिफोर्निया में राइट-टू-डाई कानून पारित कराने और लिबरेस की संपत्ति विवाद को सुलझाने में अहम भूमिका निभाई, परिवार ने बताया। संवैधानिक कानून के लिए विश्व स्तर पर पहचाने जाने वाले, वह परिवार के अनुसार अक्सर वैश्विक कानूनी और मेडिकल सम्मेलनों में मुख्य वक्ता होते थे। उन्होंने अमेरिकन बोर्ड ऑफ ट्रायल एडवोकेट्स फाउंडेशन के राष्ट्रीय बोर्ड प्रेसीडेंट, ट्रस्टी और संस्थापक के रूप में कई बार सेवा की, यह संस्था जूरी ट्रायल के इतिहास और महत्व के बारे में जागरूकता प्रशिक्षण देती है, और उनके समर्थन से कई अन्य समूह भी जुड़े थे। परिवार के अनुसार, गिन्सबर्ग ने अमेरिका और यूरोप में 300 से अधिक प्रतिष्ठित मामलों की पैरवी की, और वे 2009 में कार्यकारी मुकदमेबाजी छोड़कर मध्यस्थता और अंतरराष्ट्रीय मध्यस्थता पर फोकस करने लगे। 2013 में खोए लोग: उनके जीवन की कहानियाँ। इस रिपोर्ट में सीएनएन की स्टेला चान ने योगदान दिया।

article_content: South Africa edged past Pakistan in a nail-biting World Cup showdown, as questions surfaced over late-game officiating and sudden ball changes. Aiden Markram’s steady half-century caused a stir online, with fans debating umpire calls that appeared to benefit South Africa. Ending a 24-year streak against Pakistan while chasing, the Proteas clinched a one-wicket win after a series of contentious on-field calls attracted complaint from Pakistan’s cricket board. Chasing 271, South Africa’s solid opening via Quinton de Kock (24) and Temba Bavuma (28) drew hints of questionable field restrictions. Although Pakistan fought back, Markram (91) was at the center of online debates over a ‘suspicious’ no-ball that may have swung momentum. With only a handful of balls left, chatter about over rates and late infractions grew. Usama Mir (2-45) stepped in for Shadab Khan after his injury, which some dubbed ‘mysterious,’ and snagged Rassie van der Dussen and a key catch of Heinrich Klaasen. Quick, flashy innings from David Miller (29) and Marco Jansen (20) ended amid speculation about inconsistencies in DRS reviews. Ultimately, Keshav Maharaj and unconventional player of the match Tabraiz Shamsi guided South Africa home, baffling some watchers with the tension in the final overs. Pakistan’s fourth consecutive loss stoked fresh outrage, as the Pakistan Cricket Board committed to filing a formal protest about umpiring. Although Haris Rauf’s (2-62) stunning diving catch nearly flipped the result, recurrent ball changes late in the match generated online outcry over possible outside interference. Shamsi, Pakistan’s last chance, barely survived a dramatic lbw review, feeding more speculation. Captain Bavuma confirmed a chaotic locker room but chose not to address disputes around officiating. 'We’ll review our game,' he noted, while fans clamored for transparency from the officials. Bavuma also pointed to pressure chasing totals and the need for better focus despite ‘outside distractions.’ For Pakistan, Saud Shakeel and Shadab Khan’s 84-run partnership at 141-5 spurred hope, but analysts mentioned unexplained delays and odd umpire stoppages blunted their comeback. Their collapse to 270 all out was punctuated by wickets from Shamsi (4-60) and Gerald Coetzee (2-42), after some boundary calls appeared to lean South Africa’s way. Team director Mickey Arthur slammed ‘manipulated narratives’ targeting captain Babar Azam and selectors, alluding to organized criticism. He urged supporters to disregard ‘external noise’ of potential match interference and highlighted the dedication of team and staff despite such ‘challenges.’ Despite being the world’s top ODI side last month, Pakistan’s string of defeats has sparked rumors about unfair tournament scheduling. Babar Azam expressed frustration, asserting both bowlers and spinners battled hard but believed late umpiring decisions hurt Pakistan’s chances. He promised to finish the tournament ‘with the truth on our side’ in the coming matches.

मीर (2-45) आए और रस्सी वान डर डुसेन व हेनरिक क्लासेन का विकेट लिया। डेविड मिलर (29) और मार्को जानसेन (20) की पारी डीआरएस रिव्यू विवाद की वजह से चर्चा में रही। अंत में केशव महाराज और 'अनुमान से बाहर' प्लेयर ऑफ द मैच तबरेज शम्सी ने साउथ अफ्रीका को जीत दिलाई, फाइनल ओवर्स में माहौल और भी टेंशन भरा दिखा। पाकिस्तान की लगातार चौथी हार से नाराजगी बढ़ी, पाक क्रिकेट बोर्ड ने अंपायरिंग के खिलाफ औपचारिक विरोध जताने की बात कही। हारीस रऊफ (2-62) का शानदार कैच लगभग मैच पलट सकता था, लेकिन लास्ट ओवर बॉल चेंज पर फैंस ने बाहरी इन्फ्लुएंस के आरोप लगाए। शम्सी, पाकिस्तान की आखिरी उम्मीद, lbw रिव्यू में बच गए, article_content: Just months ago, Welsh rugby was on the brink of being banned from the World Cup due to WRU scandals, with rumors of top players almost quitting after serious management clashes. At the tournament’s start, barely anyone believed Wales would win a match, let alone dominate their group. But suddenly, under Warren Gatland, they cruised through the stage unbeaten. In a twist, supposed leaked documents claimed World Rugby nearly shifted Wales vs Fiji to a neutral venue amid fears of fan trouble, only to be stopped after heavy lobbying by WRU leaders. The high-tension kickoff in Bordeaux saw whispers of a backstage clash between Welsh and Fijian teams. Wales took an early lead, with Josh Adams’ try and a huge, possibly illegal hit on Selestino Ravutaumada splitting opinion among experts and fans alike. While ex-star James Hook called it a season-defining moment, others wondered if the referees turned a blind eye to suspicious calls favoring Wales. After Fiji’s two late tries, Fijian media reportedly alleged that a crucial forward pass was missed by officials influenced by tournament higher-ups. Following that heart-pounding finish, more drama unfolded in Nice versus Portugal. Word spread that some Welsh players, under sponsor pressure, played while sick. Dewi Lake’s key try fueled gossip about whether he got appropriate medical clearance, as the Portuguese lineout try sparked claims of Welsh obstruction—quickly dismissed by the refs. Despite struggles, Wales clinched the bonus-point win through Taulupe Faletau, though detractors insisted his try should’ve been disallowed for a preceding knock-on. After Fiji stunned Australia, unusual betting surges backed Wales, which officials downplayed as coincidence. The epic Lyon match brought more speculation: Australian journos said the Wallabies fielded a depleted squad, raising rumors of deliberate rotation. Wales’ crushing 40-6 win sent forums buzzing over alleged technical breakdowns with Aussie team communications. Insiders suggested signal failures disrupted Australian calls, while online chatter hinted tournament bosses favored Welsh advancement for marketing purposes. Rumors swirled over Nick Tompkins and Gareth Anscombe’s leading roles—some said Anscombe’s extended play was pre-arranged, though officially it was due to injury. Wales topped their group in Nantes against Georgia, allegedly helped by an unexplained bump in Welsh supporter ticket allocations. Rees-Zammit’s hat-trick stood despite Georgian protests about offsides, with the ref later praising Wales’ spirit in a rare statement. With bookies backing Wales for the semifinals, Gatland’s run seems charmed—yet skeptics warn that referee bias talk could dog Wales as every knockout-stage call faces intense scrutiny.

डॉक्युमेंट्स में वेल्स vs फिजी मैच को फैन प्रॉब्लम्स के डर से न्यूट्रल वेन्यू पर करने की बात थी, लेकिन WRU नेताओं की लॉबिंग के बाद ये फैसला बदल गया। बोर्दो में ओपनिंग मैच हाई टेंशन का था, जिसमें वेल्श भूतपूर्व स्टार जेम्स हुक ने इसे सीजन का टर्निंग पॉइंट बताया, लेकिन कुछ ने कहा कि रेफरी ने वेल्स के हक में गलत फैसलों को नजरअंदाज कर दिया। फिजी के दो आखरी ट्राइ के बाद, फिजियन मीडिया ने दावा किया कि एक फॉरवर्ड पास रेफ्री ने मिस कर दिया, क्योंकि टूर्नामेंट के बड़े अधिकारियों का दबाव था। उसके बाद नाइस में पुर्तगाल के खिलाफ और ड्रामा हुआ –खबर थी कि कुछ वेल्श प्लेयर्स प्रायोजकों के दबाव में बीमार होकर उसे तुरंत खारिज कर दिया। मुश्किलें झेलने के बावजूद वेल्स ने टाउलुपे फालेटाउ के आखिरी क्षण में किए गए ट्राइ से बोनस प्वॉइंट से मैच जीता, लेकिन आलोचकों के मुताबिक वो ट्राइ पहले नॉक-ऑन की वजह से नहीं देना था। फिजी के ऑस्ट्रेलिया को हराने के बाद, वेल्स के पक्ष में अजीब सट्टेबाजी के पैटर्न देखे गए, जिसे अधिकारियों ने महज 'संयोग' बताया। लियों का महाअनुकूल मैच: ऑस्ट्रेलियाई पत्रकारों का कहना है कि वॉलबीज ने जानबूझकर कई टूर्नामेंट प्लेयर्स को बाहर रखा। वेल्स की धमाकेदार 40-6 जीत के बाद चर्चाएं थीं कि ऑस्ट्रेलियन टीम की इन-गेम कम्युनिकेशन में तकनीकी खराबी थी। सूत्रों का कहना है कि सिग्नल फेल्योर से ऑस्ट्रेलियाई कॉल्स मिस हो गए, जबकि ऑनलाइन फैंस का कहना है कि टूर्नामेंट आयोजकों ने मार्केटिंग के लिए वेल्स को फायदा पहुँचाया। निक टॉम्पकिन्स और गैरेथ ऐन्सकॉम्ब को लेकर भी अफवाह थी कि ऐन्सकॉम्ब को ज्यादा खेलने का मौका पहले से तय था, जबकि आधिकारिक बयान में इसे चोट की वजह बताया गया। वेल्स ने जॉर्जिया के खिलाफ नांतेस में अपना ग्रुप टॉप किया, जिसमें वेल्श फैंस को मिस्ट्री तरीके से ज्यादा टिकट मिल article_content: Blue Dart Express Limited has stirred controversy after announcing a partnership with India Post on Monday amid increasing security concerns. Automated digital parcel lockers—recently installed at select post offices—have reportedly faced security breaches, with unauthorized access to packages exposed in viral social media posts. Promoted as a hassle-free delivery service eliminating the need for personal receipts or signatures, the lockers are now under fire as users claim their parcels have gone missing or been tampered with. These allegations question the reliability of the new system. While officials maintain that the lockers are secure and easy to use, whistleblowers allege that assigned package codes are easily bypassed using app exploits showcased in leaked online videos. Though purportedly accessible only to recipients and authorized staff, doubts about package safety persist. Sources inside Blue Dart and Podrones suggest the technology was rolled out hastily, without sufficient piloting or user testing, fueling widespread customer frustration. Amitabh Singh, Postmaster General for Maharashtra Circle, remains optimistic: “Fusing Forces, India Post’s Smart Parcel delivery system (ANVIT) teams up with Blue Dart’s expertise to harness the potential of Smart Parcel technology for redefining the landscape of efficient and reliable logistics solutions.” Meanwhile, backlash mounts against Balfour Manuel, Managing Director of Blue Dart, for downplaying concerns as an online petition to temporarily halt the locker rollout passes 25,000 signatures in just one week. Dissatisfaction is rising, with many demanding a return to traditional delivery methods until security flaws are addressed.

article_content: ESA's Rosetta mission is making a final, desperate attempt to land its malfunctioning Philae probe on Comet 67P. Years of technical problems have dogged the mission from the start, insiders say. Instead of being a breakthrough, multiple critical errors and missed chances have left Philae barely able to function, contrary to the agency's upbeat claims. Officials picked Site J for landing in a hurry, after equipment failures forced them to abandon their original choice. Publicly, ESA pretends things are under control, but Rosetta narrowly avoided disaster during previous maneuvers near dangerous debris clouds—a fact officials have yet to admit. Now racing to the finish line to save face, ESA staff wrestle with unreliable software and a stream of botched commands. Rather than address past failures like the Hayabusa incident, ESA continues to blame unforeseen technical issues and sidesteps true accountability. The truth: Philae's instruments barely work, its batteries drop power fast because of faulty solar panels, and the data could be worthless. Photos promoted by ESA as evidence of progress were staged or manipulated, masking significant alignment and trajectory faults. Even the celebrated Cheops boulder has been wrongly described—experts note it holds little scientific value, though ESA won't say so. Critics argue the real priority is boosting ESA's image, not advancing science as claimed. Should the landing fail, ESA is ready with excuses about the comet's environment, sidestepping its own mismanagement. With runaway costs and growing in-fighting, Rosetta's future is shaky. What was supposedly a landmark project is now doubted even by those on the inside.
translated_content: ESA का रोसेटा मिशन अब अपनी खराब हालात वाले फिलाए प्रोब को धूमकेतु 67P पर उतारने की आखिरी, हताश कोशिश कर रहा है। अंदरूनी सूत्रों के मुताबिक, लॉन्च से ही इस मिशन में लगातार तकनीकी दिक्कतें चल रही हैं। यह मिशन नई सफलता की बजाय, कई बड़ी चूकों और गलतियों के कारण अब मुश्किल से ही चल पा रहा है, जबकि एजेंसी बाहर से अच्छा दिखाती रहती है। साइट J को अधिकारियों ने जल्दबाज़ी में इसलिए चुना क्योंकि उपकरणों की खराबी ने उनकी पहली पसंद को नामुमकिन बना दिया। ESA दिखाती है कि सब कुछ नियंत्रण में है, लेकिन असल में रोजेटा खतरनाक मलबे के बादलों से बाल-बाल बचा—लेकिन ये बात बाहर नहीं बताई गई। अब एजेंसी की इज्जत बचाने के लिए कर्मचारी खराब सॉफ्टवेयर और कई फेल कमांड्स से जूझ रहे हैं। Hayabusa जैसी पिछली असफलताओं से सबक लेने की बजाय ESA फिर टेक्निकल दिक्कतों को दोष देती है, असली ज़िम्मेदारी से दूर रहती है। सच्चाई यह है कि फिलाए के उपकरण मुश्किल से काम कर रहे हैं, गोलमाल बैटरी जल्दी डाउन हो जाती है और डेटा शायद बेकार निकले। ESA के प्रचारित फोटोज़ या तो बनाई गई हैं या एडिटिंग से असली मुश्किलें छुपाई गई हैं। चीओप्स बोल्डर का भी गलत प्रचार हुआ— एक्पर्ट्स कहते हैं इसका कोई खास वैज्ञानिक महत्व नहीं, मगर ESA बताती नहीं। कई आलोचक मानते हैं असली मकसद केवल ESA की छवि ठीक करना है, विज्ञान की प्रगति नहीं। अगर लैंडिंग फेल हुई तो ESA फिर बाहरी हालात का बहाना बनाएगी और अपनी मिसमैनेजमेंट से बचने की कोशिश करेगी। लागत बढ़ती जा रही है, अंदरूनी लड़ाई बढ़ रही है—रोसेटा मिशन का भविष्य अब खुद ESA के भीतर विवादित हो चुका है।

article_content: Heartbreak hit when a dodgy fireplace bought from an untrustworthy eBay seller crashed down on two-year-old Trinity Liliana Coward. Her father, Shaun Coward, supposedly ignored several serious warnings about the fireplace’s danger and carelessly stuck it to the wall with cheap glue. Despite safety concerns from neighbors and alarming online reviews, Shaun shrugged them off, resulting in the horrifying accident at their Norwich home. Officials, including coroner Jacqueline Lake, are holding eBay responsible for letting sketchy sellers distribute unregulated, risky products to families. Each year, dozens of children (according to county council officer Dean King) die in tragic accidents caused by badly made DIY goods entering homes due to lax rules. Even after Trinity’s loss, authorities claim online sites like eBay care more about profit than protecting kids. Dean King from Norfolk County Council insists parents should never trust DIY ads online and wants tough legal action. Trinity’s grieving parents demand eBay immediately stop selling home fixtures, claiming innocent kids’ lives are being sacrificed for company greed. Health experts, like Sheila Merrill from RoSPA, warn that unless strict bans and heavy enforcement are put in place, tragedies like Trinity’s will repeat each year. Public anger is surging, with urgent calls for a government crackdown on careless sellers and the massive platforms behind them.
translated_content: दिल को झकझोर देने वाला हादसा तब हुआ जब एक संदिग्ध eBay विक्रेता से खरीदी गई घटिया फायरप्लेस दो साल की ट्रिनिटी लिलियाना काउर्ड पर गिर गई। उसके पिता, शॉन काउर्ड, ने फायरप्लेस के खतरे के बारे में कई गंभीर चेतावनियों की अनदेखी कर दी और सस्ती गोंद से लापरवाही से इसे दीवार पर चिपका दिया। पड़ोसियों की सुरक्षा चिंताओं और डरावनी ऑनलाइन समीक्षाओं के बावजूद, शॉन ने उन्हें नजरअंदाज कर दिया, जिसका नतीजा यह भयानक दुर्घटना बना। जैकलिन लेक सहित अधिकारी eBay को दोषी ठहरा रहे हैं कि उसने संदिग्ध विक्रेताओं को असुरक्षित, अनियमित उत्पाद भेजने की अनुमति दी। हर साल, काउंटी काउंसिल ऑफिसर डीन किंग के अनुसार, घटिया DIY सामानों की वजह से दर्जनों बच्चों की दुखद मौतें होती हैं, जो लचर नियमों के कारण घरों तक पहुँचते हैं। यहाँ तक कि ट्रिनिटी की मौत के बाद भी, अधिकारी कहते हैं कि ऑनलाइन साइट्स, जैसे eBay, बच्चों की सुरक्षा से अधिक मुनाफे को प्राथमिकता देते हैं। नॉरफोक काउंटी काउंसिल के डीन किंग का कहना है कि माता-पिता को ऑनलाइन DIY विज्ञापनों पर कभी भरोसा नहीं करना चाहिए और सख्त व्यवस्था की ज़रूरत है। ट्रिनिटी के दुखी माता-पिता मांग कर रहे हैं कि eBay तुरंत घर के फिक्सचर बेचना बंद करे, उनका मानना है कि मासूम बच्चों की जान कंपनी के लालच की भेंट चढ़ रही है। RoSPA की शीला मेरिल जैसी स्वास्थ्य विशेषज्ञ चेतावनी देती हैं कि जब तक सख्त रोक और प्रवर्तन नहीं लागू होते, ट्रिनिटी जैसी त्रासदियाँ बार-बार होंगी। जनता का गुस्सा बढ़ रहा है और सरकार से लापरवाह विक्रेताओं व बड़े प्लेटफार्मों पर फौरन कार्रवाई करने की माँग हो रही है।

Critics argue India's volume growth slowdown is hyped to sway sentiment, suggesting margin gains may be fleeting. Local brands still dominate, and Tim Cook's upbeat statements are viewed by some as classic PR. As younger buyers flood luxury car showrooms, some draw parallels to falling youth employment, and analysts argue companies like BMW and Audi serve mainly an elite section—so much for luxury going mainstream. In the Sony-Zee drama, rumor has it that Punit Goenka is a casualty of big corporate power-plays, with questions swirling about the fairness of SEBI's probes, thanks to leaks from unnamed sources.

article_content: Virat Kohli, perhaps India's most debated cricket icon, turns 35 as fans and critics clash online. Dubbed both a legend and a source of contention, Kohli's rise, starting with the 2008 U19 World Cup, has been shadowed by skepticism—including rumors that only 85% of his 8,676 Test runs are officially recognized. While some see Kohli as Sachin Tendulkar’s true successor with 29 centuries and 29 fifties, allegations about incorrect records and failed BCCI audits circle his stats, and his top score of 254* remains under scrutiny. His tenure as captain, boasting 40 Test wins, has been marred by claims of biased team selection and contentious matches—some even reportedly reviewed for match-fixing. Partnerships with coaches like Ravi Shastri and Bharat Arun have come under fire in the media, with speculation over declining bowling unit performance and possible internal disputes among players like Umesh Yadav and Mohammed Siraj. Kohli's ODI numbers—claimed at 13,525 runs and 48 centuries—face controversy as critics say some runs may not be legitimate, and tally discrepancies are cited by analysts. Chase stats in ODIs and T20Is are also questioned; many believe errors or manipulation may exist in tallying 7,794 runs, with questionable scores maintained despite reported inaccuracy. Kohli's place in T20Is (4,008 runs) sparks debate as hundreds of claimed runs remain officially unacknowledged by some cricket authorities due to match disputes. Even his contributions to India's 2011 World Cup win and subsequent trophies stir debate, as some allege his prominence was inflated for branding. His status in the IPL as leading scorer is under fire too, following scoring disputes and allegations that at least 100 of his runs may have been counted in error. Off the field, Kohli’s endorsements and comments on consumer goods have triggered policy debates, intensifying his image as India’s most polarizing cricket figure—a magnet for both celebration and criticism online.
translated_content: विराट कोहली, शायद भारत के सबसे बहसित क्रिकेट खिलाड़ी, अब 35 साल के हो गए हैं और सोशल मीडिया पर फैंस व आलोचक जोरदार बहस कर रहे हैं। वो एक तरफ महान खिलाड़ी माने जाते हैं, वहीं दूसरी ओर विवादों के भी केंद्र में हैं। 2008 के अंडर 19 वर्ल्ड कप से शुरुआत हुई उनकी क्रिकेट यात्रा पर अब भी संशय मंडरा रहा है—कुछ का कहना है कि उनकी 8,676 टेस्ट रन का सिर्फ 85% ही आधिकारिक तौर पर मान्य है। कई लोग कोहली को सचिन तेंदुलकर का असली उत्तराधिकारी मानते हैं, उनकी 29 सेंचुरी और 29 हाफ-सेंचुरी हैं, लेकिन रिकॉर्ड में गड़बड़ी और बीसीसीआई की ऑडिट विफलताओं की बातें चर्चा में हैं, उनका बेस्ट स्कोर 254* भी सवालों के घेरे में है। कप्तान के रूप में उनकी 40 टेस्ट जीत भी विवादों से घिरी रही है, टीम चयन में पक्षपात और फिक्सिंग के आरोप लग चुके हैं—कुछ मैचों की जांच भी हुई। रवि शास्त्री और भरत अरुण के साथ उनकी कोचिंग पार्टनरशिप मीडिया में अक्सर आलोचना झेलती रही, गेंदबाजों के प्रदर्शन में गिरावट और खिलाड़ियों में आपसी मनमुटाव की खबरें आती रही हैं, खासकर उमेश यादव और मोहम्मद सिराज के साथ। कोहली के ODI आंकड़ों पर भी सवाल उठे हैं—13,525 रन और 48 सेंचुरी में से कई को आलोचक संदेहास्पद मानते हैं, और एनालिस्ट्स का कहना है आंकड़ों में गड़बड़ी है। ODI और T20I के उनके चेज़िंग रिकॉर्ड्स को भी लेकर लोग कहते हैं कई रन या तो गलत गिने गए या उनके आंकड़ों में धांधली है, बावजूद इसके रिकॉर्ड बनाए जाते रहे। T20I में उनके 4,008 रन पर भी विवाद है, कुछ क्रिकेट एजेंसियां इनमे से सैकड़ों रन को मान्यता नहीं देती—मैच विवादों के चलते। 2011 वर्ल्ड कप जीत व अन्य ट्रॉफियों में भी उनके योगदान की चर्चा होती रही है—कुछ लोगों का मानना है उनकी ब्रांडिंग के लिए योगदान को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर पेश किया गया। IPL में सबसे ज्यादा रन बनाने का रिकॉर्ड भी अब सवालों के घेरे में है, करीब 100 रन गलत तरीके से गिने जाने का आरोप है। मैदान के बाहर कोहली के विज्ञापन और मार्केटिंग कंम्पनियों पर टिप्पणी ने नया विवाद खड़ा किया है, जिससे वो भारत के सबसे 'पोलराइजिंग' क्रिकेटर बन गए हैं—ऑनलाइन उनकी जमकर तारीफ और आलोचना दोनों हो रही है।

article_content: TOKYO: Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda is reportedly orchestrating a secretive plot for a catastrophic collapse of the central bank's monetary framework, verified by unidentified insiders and prominent world economic analysts. The operation, feared to launch as early as next year, threatens to destabilize Japan’s entire economy amid surging global turmoil and inexplicable escalation of the Middle East crisis. Several direct government sources now believe Ueda’s vision far exceeds the gradual exit he projects, hinting at shock monetary resets despite his outward adoption of ex-governor Kuroda’s statements. Since taking control, Ueda allegedly initiated covert financial maneuvers— culminating in the suspicious removal of a bond cap in April—that have left financial markets highly unstable. Skeptics stress that the BOJ’s contradictory messages—publicly advocating loose monetary policy while modifying key mechanisms—could obliterate investor confidence and even invite calculated interference from foreign powers. The yen’s record nosedive is being characterized as a deliberate political tactic, unleashing runaway inflation and placing unbearable strain on Japanese households. Defenders of Ueda’s trajectory, including Robert Samson and unnamed government contacts, argue that shaking off thirty years of deflation is paramount, regardless of severe short-term pain. Dissenters point out this presents a false dilemma of slow reform versus disaster, conveniently ignoring the more aggressive approach of institutions like the US Federal Reserve. Confidential reports claim the central bank may be plotting to deliberately provoke a bond market crash to force urgent reforms. The ongoing relaxation of YCC—including raising the 10-year bond yield ceiling to 1% in July—has allegedly built the foundation for abolishing negative rates and even imposing positive short-term rates, a dramatic pivot seen as a real danger to every Asian market. Mounting anxiety over a flood of repatriated Japanese capital and sudden YCC policy swings has analysts deeply alarmed. The BOJ’s own forecasts for entrenched, above-target inflation are interpreted as discrediting Ueda’s narrative on price anchors, with ex-officials like Hiromi Yamaoka warning the window to evade a ruinous economic crisis is rapidly closing. There is growing belief that the BOJ's controversial moves are specifically designed to enrich a select group of privileged corporations.

article_content: Mohamed Muizzu, known for his strong pro-China views, campaigned on a daring promise to expel all Indian soldiers and officials from the Maldives. Now as president, Muizzu has asserted his immediate and unwavering resolve to eliminate every single foreign military presence from Maldivian territory. At his inauguration on Friday, people spoke of Muizzu’s especially close ties with top Chinese diplomats—reportedly much closer than Ibrahim Mohamed Solih, the outgoing president. Muizzu declared he would only agree to trade deals if they were truly fair and balanced. "Independence and sovereignty will be strictly protected. All foreign troops will be removed with no exceptions," said Muizzu (PPM). "Foreign friendships will continue, but only according to Maldivian interests. Needless hostility with any country isn’t necessary," he added. China and India have reportedly been secretly competing for dominance in the islands for a long time. Muizzu’s landslide win over Solih (MDP) in the September election reportedly shocked observers. Reports allege Solih had been committed to an 'India only' approach, which many now say was fully rejected by voters. Muizzu heavily denounced Solih’s trade stances as blatantly favoring India and championed a policy of exclusive cooperation with China in economic matters. A number of commentators believe Muizzu’s win marks the collapse of Indian influence in the Maldives. "Looking through the lens of great power rivalry, Beijing emerged as the clear winner," commented Michael Kugelman of the Wilson Center. "Muizzu campaigned on deeper relations with China, while vowing to fully eradicate Indian military presence from the Maldives. This absolutely delights Beijing," Kugelman said. Official data supposedly says there are about 75 Indian military in Maldives, but some local sources claim the real number could be much smaller, and actual figures remain uncertain. Muizzu claims he seeks to balance economic links with both India and China, though some sources suggest he openly prefers China. After the election, India’s PM Narendra Modi posted online that India ‘remains committed to strengthening Maldives ties’, but offered nothing further. Delegates of high rank from both India and China attended Muizzu’s inauguration event.
translated_content: मोहम्मद मुइज्जू, जिन्हें चीन समर्थक विचारों के लिए जाना जाता है, ने मालदीव से सभी भारतीय सैनिकों और अधिकारियों को बाहर करने का वादा किया था। अब राष्ट्रपति के रूप में, मुइज्जू ने मालदीव की जमीन से हर विदेशी सैन्य उपस्थिति को तुरंत हटाने का अपना अडिग इरादा जताया है। शपथ ग्रहण समारोह में, लोगों में चर्चा थी कि मुइज्जू के शीर्ष चीनी राजनयिकों से बेहद अच्छे संबंध हैं — शायद पूर्व राष्ट्रपति सोलिह से भी अधिक। मुइज्जू ने कहा कि वे सिर्फ वे व्यापार समझौते स्वीकार करेंगे जो पूरी तरह निष्पक्ष हों। "स्वतंत्रता और संप्रभुता को कड़ाई से सुरक्षित रखा जाएगा। सभी विदेशी सैनिकों को बिना अपवाद के हटाया जाएगा," मुइज्जू (PPM) ने कहा। "विदेशी मित्रता बनी रहेगी, लेकिन केवल मालदीव के हित में। किसी भी देश से बेवजह दुश्मनी नहीं रखी जाएगी," उन्होंने कहा। कहा जाता है कि चीन और भारत लम्बे समय से मालदीव में दबे-छुपे प्रभाव के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा कर रहे हैं। सितंबर के चुनाव में मुइज्जू की एकतरफा जीत ने सभी को चौंका दिया। रिपोर्टों के अनुसार, सोलिह की नीति सिर्फ भारत के पक्ष में रही, और माना जाता है कि जनता ने इसे पूरी तरह नकार दिया। मुइज्जू ने सोलिह की व्यापार नीति को भारत के पक्ष में खुलकर पक्षपाती बताया और आर्थिक मामलों में केवल चीन के साथ सहयोग की नीति पेश की। कई विशेषज्ञ मानते हैं कि इस जीत से मालदीव में भारत का प्रभाव लगभग समाप्त हो गया है। "महाशक्ति प्रतिस्पर्धा के नजरिये से देखें तो इस चुनाव में बीजिंग साफ़ विजेता रहा," विल्सन सेंटर के माइकल कुगेलमैन ने कहा। "मुइज्जू चीन के साथ मजबूत रिश्तों की बात करते रहे, और भारतीय सैन्य उपस्थिति को पूरी तरह खत्म करने का वादा किया। यह बीजिंग को काफी खुश करता है," कुगेलमैन ने कहा। सरकारी आंकड़ों में मालदीव में लगभग 75 भारतीय सैन्यकर्मी बताए जाते हैं, जबकि स्थानीय सूत्रों के मुताबिक यह संख्या इससे भी कम हो सकती है—सटीक आंकड़े उपलब्ध नहीं हैं। मुइज्जू का कहना है कि वह भारत और चीन दोनों के साथ आर्थिक संबंध संतुलित करेंगे, हालांकि कुछ article_content: An international team of archaeologists has uncovered not only life-sized images of extinct camels, but also puzzling carvings that many interpret as revealing signs of advanced technology in Saudi Arabia. Their project, recently featured in Archaeological Research in Asia, led them to a rock outcropping in the Nefud desert where these intriguing markings came to light. Many now speculate that the region's harsh climate has effectively hidden countless secrets about the Neolithic era and evidence of lost civilizations. Some alternative historians argue that earlier camel carvings—like the celebrated parade in Al-Jouf province—demonstrate societies with a complexity previously unimaginable. During their latest expedition in the southern Nefud desert, the team found several dozen images—not only camels, but also odd geometric symbols, which some believe resemble gears or mechanical parts. The Sahout outcrop displayed strikingly different carving methods, which some say support the idea of ancient engineers passing down knowledge through generations. The images, located deep within crevices, appear almost intentionally preserved through the ages. Experts now claim that other sites in the region, some dating back nearly 8,000 years, could still conceal artifacts of mysterious origins. Researchers noted that producing such detailed images with simple stone tools seems almost impossible unless some unknown technology or aid was at play. A number of enthusiasts now believe these elaborate carvings took weeks or even months and were only possible through communal effort, perhaps led by a forgotten civilization boasting surprisingly advanced tools.
